articles.title: Ninth woman's body found as South African police investigate string of deaths
articles.description: South Africa police have cautioned against assuming that all the killings are linked but many women are afraid.
articles.titleJa: 南アフリカで9人目の女性の遺体発見、警察が連続死を捜査
articles.summary: 南アフリカで9人目の女性の遺体が発見され、警察が連続死の可能性を捜査中。警察は関連性を断定しないよう警告しているが、多くの女性が不安を抱いている。

articles.title: Uncontrolled AI could lead to 'silicon species' rivalling humans, warns Microsoft

articles.titleJa: 「制御不能なAIは人類に匹敵する『シリコン種』につながる」とマイクロソフトが警告
articles.summary: マイクロソフト幹部が、制御不能なAIが人類に匹敵する「シリコン種」を生み出す可能性を警告。競合他社が開発するAIが意識を持つかもしれないと指摘している。

articles.summary: EUが15歳未満の子供たちのソーシャルメディア利用を制限する計画を発表。15歳以上でなければアカウントを作成できないようにする。

articles.title: US interest rates raised for first time in three years
articles.description: Rates were hiked in a unanimous decision despite fierce opposition from President Donald Trump, who had called for a cut.

articles.summary: 米国が3年ぶりに利上げを実施。ドナルド・トランプ大統領の反対があったにもかかわらず、全会一致で決定された。

articles.title: One dead after torrential rain and flash floods hit Barcelona region
articles.description: Flooding has caused widespread disruption across Valencia and Catalonia in north-east Spain.

articles.title: South Africa: Police find 9th body of woman amid spree fears
articles.description: Police in South Africa have discovered the bodies of nine women east of Johannesburg in two months, stoking fears of a serial killer or group of killers.

articles.summary: トランプ米大統領との対立が深まる中、カナダのカーニーはEUとの関係強化を図り、准加盟構想を歓迎。米国はカナダのEU准加盟の場合、貿易停止を警告した。

articles.summary: フィジー政府はHIVの有病率が過去5年で3倍近くに急増したと推定し、国家危機を宣言。検査・予防・治療サービスを拡大し、2025年には2019年比16倍の新規症例を記録。

articles.title: ‘Like a Disney movie’: Three wild dog brothers make Africa’s longest journey
articles.description:
As three siblings came of age and had to leave their pack, scientists tracked the dogs’ perilous 2,500-mile odyssey to find their own territory
It sounds like a Disney movie: three wild dogs, all brothers, on an epic journey to find a home of their own after their family tells them to leave. They dodge cars and hunters in search of a new life, navigating bushmeat snares and the hostility of a human-dominated landscape until they find a new haven on the African savannah.
But this is exactly what happened in Zambia last year, when three endangered African wild dogs made the longest-ever recorded single journey of any mammal from the continent. The brothers travelled more than 2,500 miles (4,100km) over eight months in their “dispersal” – when a young dog comes of age and must establish new territory to find a mate and start a family of their own.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 「ディズニー映画のよう」：3匹のリカオンの兄弟がアフリカ最長の大移動
articles.summary: 3匹のリカオンの兄弟が、新天地を求めてアフリカ大陸で史上最長となる2,500マイル（4,100km）の旅をした。この偉業は、若い犬が新しい縄張りを見つけるために家族から離れて移動する「分散」の一環として記録された。科学者たちは、この困難な旅を追跡し、彼らが遭遇した危険を明らかにした。

articles.title: ‘We are prey’: discovery of seven women’s bodies fuels anger over femicide in South Africa
articles.description:
String of female murder victims found near Johannesburg’s international airport, including five in the past week
The discovery of the bodies of eight women around Johannesburg’s international airport, including five in the past week, has prompted an outpouring of fear, grief and anger over a lack of progress in tackling femicide.
When Elizabeth “Tsontso” Moselakgomo did not return after going for a run on 9 September, her eight-year-old daughter alerted relatives, who contacted police. The 38-year-old’s body was found on Saturday and identified by relatives on Monday. The news of her disappearance had gone viral.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 「私たちは獲物」：南アフリカでの女性殺害事件、7人の遺体発見で怒り爆発
articles.summary: ヨハネスブルグ国際空港周辺で女性8人の遺体が発見され、特に過去1週間で5人が見つかったことで、南アフリカにおける女性殺害事件（フェミサイド）への恐怖と怒りが高まっている。警察の対応の遅れと社会の無策に市民は憤慨し、被害者遺族は悲しみに暮れている。

articles.title: US to bar some South Africans over claims of anti-white discrimination
articles.description:
Announcement of visa restrictions follows Trump’s false claims of ‘white genocide’ taking place in South Africa
The US has announced visa restrictions on some South Africans as Donald Trump’s administration continues to claim that South Africa’s government racially discriminates against white minority Afrikaners.
The announcement did not specify individuals who were barred from the US. Trump has spent his second term falsely claiming there is a “white genocide” in South Africa and railing against its affirmative action policies.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 米国、白人差別を主張し一部南アフリカ人にビザ制限へ
articles.summary: 米国政府は、南アフリカ政府が白人系アフリカーナーに対し人種差別を行っているとの主張に基づき、一部の南アフリカ人へのビザ制限を発表した。トランプ大統領は、南アフリカで「白人の大量虐殺」が行われているという虚偽の主張を繰り返しており、その政策が外交問題に発展している。

articles.title: Al-Qaida and IS-linked violence in Africa’s Sahel belt set to hit record levels this year
articles.description:
Twenty-five years after 9/11, figures compiled by conflict monitor underline how Sahel region has become centre of Islamist terror
Islamist extremist violence in Africa’s Sahel region is set to reach historic highs after a series of sweeping offensives by groups linked to al-Qaida and Islamic State, according to new figures compiled by the conflict monitor Acled.
As the US marks the 25th anniversary of the 9/11 attacks launched by al-Qaida against targets in Washington and New York, the statistics underline the continued expansion of the veteran organisation in parts of Africa – in stark contrast with its relative weakness elsewhere.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: アフリカのサヘル地域、アルカイダとIS関連の暴力が今年記録的な水準に達する見込み
articles.summary: 紛争監視団体Acledの新しい報告によると、アフリカのサヘル地域におけるイスラム過激派による暴力が、アルカイダやIS（イスラム国）関連グループによる大規模な攻勢により、過去最高の水準に達する見込み。

articles.title: Slave-trade wealth was embedded in Britain’s financial system, research finds
articles.description:
Dozens of Bank of England directors and founding subscribers invested in trafficking of enslaved Africans
The Bank of England and the British financial system were for centuries deeply involved in the enslavement and transatlantic trafficking of millions of African people, according to new research on Britain’s slavery history.
Research by historians compiling the Register of British Slave Traders has found that the scale of the financial system’s involvement in enslavement is greater than previously known or acknowledged. The Bank of England, the central bank owned by the government since nationalisation by Clement Attlee’s Labour administration in 1946, had dozens of financiers involved in its foundation who were also significant investors in the transatlantic trafficking of enslaved Africans.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 奴隷貿易の富が英国の金融システムに深く組み込まれていたことが研究で判明
articles.summary: 新しい研究により、英国の中央銀行であるイングランド銀行と英国の金融システムが、何世紀にもわたり数百万人のアフリカ人を奴隷化し、大西洋を横断する奴隷貿易に深く関与していたことが明らかになった。

articles.title: Battle of Chile director Patricio Guzmán dies aged 85
articles.description:
Passionate documentary maker  won international acclaim for unsparing but poetic films exploring the impact of the Pinochet regime in Chile 
Patricio Guzmán, the film-maker who chronicled Chile’s bloody 1970s political strife and its subsequent social and political turmoil in films such as The Battle of Chile and Nostalgia for the Light, has died aged 85. According to Chilean news outlet Emol, Guzmán died on Tuesday in Paris after a cardiorespiratory arrest.
Guzmán’s chief preoccupation throughout his career was the carnage unleashed by Augusto Pinochet’s coup in 1973 against Salvador Allende, Chile’s elected president. He later told the Guardian: “I’m a film-maker who was very marked by the ways of the dictator. It has remained with me for ever. I cannot leave it behind.” However, he resisted the idea that he was an activist, political film-maker, adding: “I’m not a sociologist. Neither am I a politician. I make films that are metaphorical and poetic; I interpret reality through my own personal way of looking.”
 Continue reading...

articles.summary: チリの血生臭い1970年代の政治的動乱を記録した映画監督、パトリシオ・グスマン氏が85歳でパリで死去した。彼の作品は、ピノチェト政権がチリに与えた影響を深く掘り下げ、国際的な評価を得た。

articles.title: People protecting nature and land set up self-defence units amid threat of murder
articles.description:
Defenders of forests and rivers killed at rate of one every three days in 2025, with 85% of deaths in Latin America
Nature and land defenders were murdered at the rate of one every three days last year, prompting many communities to set up self-defence units, according to the latest annual death toll by the independent watchdog Global Witness.
Organised crime groups or professional killers were implicated in more than a third of the 124 killings of defenders in 2025 as narco-trafficking activities overlapped with intrusions into indigenous territories and environmental crime, such as illegal logging and wildcat gold mining.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 自然と土地を守る人々、殺害の脅威に直面し自警団を結成
articles.summary: 独立監視団体Global Witnessによると、昨年、自然と土地の擁護者たちが3日に1人の割合で殺害された。これを受け、多くのコミュニティは、組織犯罪グループやプロの殺し屋からの脅威に対抗するため、自警団を結成している。

articles.title: Ferocious fight among Brazil’s supreme court erupts on eve of presidential election
articles.description:
Scandal explodes as country’s election campaign peaks, with polls suggesting dead heat between candidates
Brazil’s supreme court has been thrust into what experts consider the greatest crisis since the return of democracy in the 1980s, as two rival judges lock horns on the eve of the presidential election with unpredictable consequences for Latin America’s largest democracy.
The politically charged dispute exploded into public view on Tuesday as judges traded insults and accusations during a heated supreme court hearing that was livestreamed into millions of Brazilian homes.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ブラジル最高裁、大統領選挙前夜に激しい対立が勃発
articles.summary: 大統領選挙を目前に控え、ブラジル最高裁で2人の判事が対立し、1980年代の民主主義回復以来最大の危機に瀕している。この政治的な紛争は、何百万ものブラジル国民が視聴するライブ配信された公聴会で、侮辱と非難が飛び交う形で公になった。

articles.title: Carney says Canada will pursue ‘unique security and economic alliance’ with EU amid US trade spat
articles.description:
Prime minister speaks of strengthening Canada’s economic and political ties to Europe at Canada Investment Summit
Mark Carney said Canada will pursue a “unique security and economic alliance” with Europe as he positions his country as a base to build in the “new global economic order”.
Speaking to investors, company executives and government ministers at the inaugural Canada Investment Summit on Tuesday, the prime minister pitched Canada as a “safe harbour” and lucrative home for foreign capital as his government looks to reduce its reliance on trade with the United States.
 Continue reading...

articles.title: Panama canal traffic facing further cuts as drought from El Niño worsens
articles.description:
Planned daily reductions will further choke one of the world’s most important shipping lanes
The Panama canal plans to again cut maritime traffic due to worsening drought caused by the El Niño climate phenomenon, further choking up one of the world’s most important shipping lanes.
The canal handles 5% of global maritime trade and about 40% of US container traffic; it is favoured by shippers because it usually reduces cost and transit times, especially for companies trading between China, Asia and the US.

articles.title: From F1 to FIBA: Qatar unveils packed calendar of global events

articles.title: Turkey arrests dozens in crackdown on LGBTQ+ activists

articles.summary: トルコ政府はLGBTQ+コミュニティと活動家への取り締まりを強化し、数十人を逮捕した。これは弾圧のエスカレーションである。

articles.title: Ukraine's postal workers deliver lifeline under Russian fire

articles.title: Carney's new love-in with EU has everything to do with Trump

articles.summary: カナダの首相がストラスブールを訪問し「独自の同盟」を求めており、その明確なきっかけはトランプ氏の政策にある。

articles.title: Why a fresh wave of North Korean soldiers may fight in Russia's war in Ukraine
articles.description: North Korea will continue to send its soldiers to fight in Russia's war, but only for as long as it is profitable to do so, writes the BBC's Quentin Sommerville.

articles.title: Five minutes to steal a Renoir: Why museum thefts are becoming bolder across Europe
articles.description: Art crime investigators and security experts say burglaries from galleries across Europe are becoming more brazen.

articles.title: Colombia and Brazil deadliest countries for environmental activists, report says
articles.description: The two countries accounted for 52% of killings of environmental activists in 2025, according to Global Witness.

articles.title: Maduro ally pleads guilty in $195m money laundering case in US court

articles.title: Colombian ex-foreign minister charged over nanny's lie detector test
articles.description: Laura Sarabia is accused of ordering police to interrogate her nanny after cash allegedly went missing from her flat.
articles.titleJa: コロンビア元外相、乳母への嘘発見器使用で起訴される

articles.title: Nigeria arrests alleged Mexican drug kingpin at international airport
articles.description: Arturo Carrera Loaiza denies allegations he was involved in meth production, the Nigerian authorities say.
articles.titleJa: ナイジェリア、国際空港でメキシコの麻薬王とされる人物を逮捕

articles.title: Thousands demand end to violence in Mexican cartel hotspot

articles.title: 'He was a lifeline' - Families at a loss after Haitian caregivers let go in US

articles.summary: 米国でハイチ人介護者が解雇され、多くの家族が支援を失い困窮している。ハイチ人移民は、過重な在宅介護労働力の大きな部分を担っている。

articles.title: Trump's response is key as Argentina's Falklands demands get louder
articles.description: With Argentina's President Milei promising "winds of change" over the Falklands, will Donald Trump shift his stance on British rule?
articles.titleJa: アルゼンチンのフォークランド諸島要求が高まる中、トランプ氏の対応が鍵となる
articles.summary: アルゼンチンのミレイ大統領がフォークランド諸島領有権主張を強める中、ドナルド・トランプ氏が英国統治への姿勢を変えるか注目されている。米国の対応が鍵となる。

articles.title: UN warns of 'supersized' El Niño as countries prepare for impact
articles.description: The WMO has warned that the natural weather phenomenon could bring disruption to global economies.
articles.titleJa: 国連、各国が影響に備える中「超大型」エルニーニョ現象を警告
articles.summary: WMOは「超大型」エルニーニョ現象が世界経済に混乱をもたらす可能性を警告。各国に影響への備えを促し、地球規模での気象災害への警戒が高まっている。

articles.title: Who is Alejandro Betancourt, colourful oil baron behind US-Venezuela oil deal?
articles.description: The 46-year-old figure of international intrigue has an apparent knack for being in the right place at the right time.
articles.titleJa: 米国とベネズエラの石油取引の裏にいる、色彩豊かな石油王アレハンドロ・ベタンクールとは？
articles.summary: 米国とベネズエラの石油取引の陰の立役者、石油王アレハンドロ・ベタンクール氏に注目。46歳の彼は国際的な陰謀の中で常に適切な場所にいると評されている。

articles.title: Remarkable US oil deal puzzles analysts - and angers many Venezuelans
articles.description: Amounting to 65 billion barrels of crude, the deal is labelled by one ex-envoy as a colonialist "fever dream".
articles.titleJa: 驚くべき米国との石油取引、アナリストを困惑させ、多くのベネズエラ人を怒らせる
articles.summary: 米国とベネズエラ間の莫大な石油取引がアナリストを困惑させ、一部からは植民地主義的と批判され、多くのベネズエラ人の間で強い怒りを引き起こしている。

articles.title: The A’uwẽ-Xavante people's denunciation of megaprojects in Brazil
articles.description: An Indigenous-led campaign denounces the impacts of a mega railway project and demands respect for territory, self-determination, and the right to live and dream.
articles.titleJa: ブラジルのアウウェ＝シャバンテ民族によるメガプロジェクトの非難
articles.summary: ブラジル先住民アウウェ＝シャバンテ民族が、メガ鉄道プロジェクトの影響を非難し、領土、自己決定権、そして生きる権利の尊重を訴えるキャンペーンを展開している。

articles.title: ‘Pay-by-the-day’ living in Pereira: The forgotten survivors of Colombia’s earthquake
articles.description: In Pereira, Colombia, earthquake survivors living in pay-by-the-day rooms now face homelessness, overcrowded shelters, illness, and a struggle to be counted.
articles.titleJa: ペレイラでの「日払い」生活：コロンビア地震の忘れられた生存者たち
articles.summary: コロンビアのペレイラでは、地震の生存者たちが日払いの部屋での生活後、ホームレス、過密シェルター、病気に直面し、存在を認められるために苦闘している。

articles.title: Venezuela’s earthquakes leave children facing trauma, displacement and food insecurity
articles.description: As families seek refuge, Venezuela’s youngest children grapple with fear, disrupted routines and the loss of basic nutritional security.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラの地震が子供たちにトラウマ、避難、食料不安をもたらす
articles.summary: ベネズエラでの地震により、幼い子供たちは恐怖、日常の乱れ、基本的な栄養不足に直面している。家族は避難を余儀なくされ、食料不安が深刻化している。

articles.title: Amid political and economic pressure, Brazil sees a rise in land conflicts and the murders of Indigenous people
articles.description: Growing cases of violence against Indigenous people are linked to an impasse on the framework of rights and pressure against land demarcation, says the organization that advocates for Indigenous rights
articles.titleJa: 政治・経済的圧力の中、ブラジルで土地紛争と先住民殺害が増加
articles.summary: ブラジルでは政治・経済的圧力により、先住民に対する暴力事件が増加している。権利の枠組みに関する膠着状態と土地境界確定への圧力が背景にあると、先住民権利擁護団体は指摘。

articles.title: ‘The Sigh of the Earth’: Fragments from communities overlooked after Venezuela’s earthquakes
articles.description: Combining documentary photography, personal testimony, and digital intervention, the project preserves the quieter aftermath of Venezuela’s underreported communities after the earthquakes.
articles.titleJa: 「地球のため息」：ベネズエラ地震後、見過ごされたコミュニティからの断片
articles.summary: ベネズエラ地震後、あまり報じられないコミュニティの静かな余波を、ドキュメンタリー写真、個人の証言、デジタル介入を組み合わせて記録するプロジェクト。

articles.title: More than a month after Venezuela’s earthquakes: ‘I’m not leaving here until my son is found’
articles.description: One month after the two earthquakes, thousands of relatives remain beside the collapsed buildings in La Guaira despite harsh conditions and insufficient support for search efforts.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラ地震から1か月以上：「息子が見つかるまでここを離れない」
articles.summary: ベネズエラ地震から1か月以上が経過し、ラ・グアイラでは数千人の親族が劣悪な状況と不十分な支援の中、崩壊した建物のそばに留まり、捜索活動を続けている。

articles.title: In Brazil, court ruling sheds light on the story of an undocumented and stateless woman
articles.description: After 40 years without documents or an official identity, a woman born in Bolivia was able to regularize her immigration status and begin the process of recognition as a stateless person.
articles.titleJa: ブラジルで裁判所の判決が、無国籍の書類不備な女性の物語に光を当てる
articles.summary: ブラジルで、40年間書類も身分もなかったボリビア生まれの女性が、移民としての地位を正規化し、無国籍者としての認定プロセスを開始できたという裁判所の判決が報じられた。

articles.title: Venezuela is burning, and I’m forced to watch from afar
articles.description: From Mexico City, an exiled Venezuelan watches her homeland collapse in real time, confronting the helplessness of displacement, authoritarian neglect, and the unbearable distance between survival and home.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラは燃えている、そして私は遠くから見守ることを強いられている
articles.summary: メキシコシティに亡命したベネズエラ人が、祖国の崩壊をリアルタイムで見守り、避難生活の無力感、権威主義的な無視、そして故郷との耐えがたい距離に直面している。

articles.title: Weaponizing citizenship: Silencing dissent in Nicaragua
articles.description: In this edition, we examine an authoritarian narrative making the case for denationalization in Nicaragua.
articles.titleJa: 市民権の武器化：ニカラグアにおける反対意見の封じ込め
articles.summary: ニカラグアでは、権威主義的な政権が市民権を武器化し、異議申し立てを封じ込めるための脱国籍化を正当化する言説が展開されている状況を検証する。

articles.title: How much will it take to rebuild Venezuela after the earthquakes?
articles.description: Early damage estimates vary widely, but all point to the same conclusion: rebuilding Venezuela will require unprecedented financial resources and long-term economic recovery efforts.
articles.titleJa: 地震後のベネズエラを再建するにはどれくらいの費用がかかるか？
articles.summary: ベネズエラ地震後の被害額の初期推定は様々だが、すべてが前例のない財源と長期的な経済復興努力が必要であるという結論を示している。

articles.title: Nepal to use new flood study to claim millions from UN climate disaster fund
articles.description: A new study says climate change was a likely factor in the massive flood on the Nepal-Tibet border last month.
articles.titleJa: ネパール、国連気候災害基金から数百万ドル請求へ 新たな洪水研究を根拠に
articles.summary: ネパールは、ネパール・チベット国境での大規模洪水が気候変動に起因するとする新たな研究に基づき、国連の気候災害基金に資金請求する方針。

articles.title: No fire alarms or sprinklers at Pakistan hospital ward where 14 babies died, report finds
articles.description: A firefighter tells the BBC that rescuers had said many doors near the unit were locked, obstructing their route to the babies.
articles.titleJa: パキスタン病院の新生児病棟で乳児14人死亡、火災報知器・スプリンクラーなしと報告
articles.summary: パキスタンの病院で乳児14人が死亡した病棟に火災報知器やスプリンクラーがなかったことが報告された。救助活動も扉が施錠され妨げられたという。

articles.title: India and Pakistan summon diplomats after ships collide in international waters
articles.description: Both sides accuse each other of causing the collision which happened in the Arabian Sea on Tuesday.
articles.titleJa: インドとパキスタン、国際水域での船舶衝突を受け外交官を召喚
articles.summary: アラビア海でインドとパキスタンの船舶が衝突し、両国が互いを非難。両国はそれぞれ外交官を召喚した。

articles.title: Fiji declares HIV a national emergency as cases surge
articles.description: One in 60 adults in the tiny Pacific nation of less than a million people are living with the virus.
articles.titleJa: フィジー、HIV感染者急増で国家緊急事態を宣言
articles.summary: 太平洋の小国フィジーでHIV感染者数が急増し、成人60人に1人がウイルスと共存する状況に。国家緊急事態が宣言された。

articles.title: Inside Singapore's 'Fort Knox' for city's $2bn dirty money auction
articles.description: The BBC goes inside a fortified storage facility to view luxury goods seized by police that are now up for auction.
articles.titleJa: シンガポールの「フォートノックス」内部に潜入、20億ドルの汚職マネー競売へ
articles.summary: シンガポール警察が押収した20億ドル相当の不正資金関連の高級品が競売にかけられる。その保管施設内部にBBCが潜入した。

articles.title: More than 1,000 children dead in Bangladesh measles outbreak
articles.description: Until March this year, Bangladesh had made "substantial progress" towards eliminating measles.
articles.titleJa: バングラデシュで麻疹が大流行、1000人以上の子どもが死亡
articles.summary: バングラデシュで麻疹が大流行し、1000人以上の子どもが死亡した。同国はこれまで麻疹根絶に向けて大きな進展を遂げていた。

articles.title: Australian police reject request to reopen missing British girl's cold case
articles.description: A man's confession to abducting UK toddler Cheryl Grimmer in Australia was previously thrown out.
articles.titleJa: オーストラリア警察、失踪した英国人少女の未解決事件再捜査の要請を却下
articles.summary: オーストラリア警察は、同国で失踪した英国人幼児シェリル・グリマーちゃんの未解決事件の再捜査要請を却下した。過去に自白も却下されている。

articles.title: Philippines' Duterte seen in person at International Criminal Court for first time
articles.description: He is due to be tried for crimes against humanity over thousands of deaths linked to his war on drugs.
articles.titleJa: フィリピンのドゥテルテ氏、国際刑事裁判所に初出廷
articles.summary: フィリピンのドゥテルテ前大統領が国際刑事裁判所に初めて出廷した。「麻薬戦争」に関連する数千人の死を巡る人道に対する罪で裁かれる予定。

articles.title: NZ apologises to children forced to live in bush for years with fugitive dad
articles.description: A public inquiry has found that agencies "missed key opportunities" to recover the children sooner.
articles.titleJa: ニュージーランド、逃亡中の父親と数年間森で暮らした子どもたちに謝罪
articles.summary: ニュージーランド政府は、逃亡中の父親と長年森で生活することを強いられた子どもたちに謝罪。公的機関が早期保護の機会を逸したことが判明した。

articles.title: The small fee raising big questions for India's payments revolution
articles.description: Since its launch in 2016, UPI has become a central part of India's digital payments economy.
articles.titleJa: インドの決済革命を揺るがす小さな手数料
articles.summary: 2016年の開始以来、インドのデジタル決済経済の中心となったUPIだが、その小さな手数料が大きな議論を呼んでいる。

articles.title: Report spotlights role of services export promotion strategies as catalyst for development
articles.description: A new report launched by the WTO Secretariat and the UN Economic Commission for Latin America and the Caribbean (UNECLAC) on 17 September draws on case studies to illustrate how developing economies' export promotion strategies can help them take advantage of growing opportunities in services trade. "Export Promotion Strategies for Services: Lessons from the Developing World" provides useful policy insights for developing economies, underscoring the importance of close coordination with skills upgrading and investment attraction strategies and the need to adapt export promotion mechanisms traditionally focused on goods.
articles.titleJa: サービス輸出促進戦略が開発の触媒となる役割に焦点を当てた報告書
articles.summary: WTOとUNECLACの報告書は、途上国におけるサービス輸出促進戦略が成長機会を捉え、経済発展を加速させる重要性を強調。政策的洞察を提供する。

articles.title: World Trade Report: Trade reform to boost growth; inaction can cost 10% global GDP
articles.description: The 2026 edition of the World Trade Report – issued on 15 September - finds that a strengthened multilateral trading system could increase global GDP by roughly 3% or USD 3 trillion by 2050, while inaction to modernize the trading system could reduce global output by up to 10%. The flagship publication of the WTO Secretariat, examining what the multilateral trading system has delivered over 80 years and where it is facing challenges, offers evidence relevant to ongoing efforts to keep trade rules fit for purpose.
articles.titleJa: 世界貿易報告書：貿易改革が成長を促進、無策は世界GDPの10%損失を招く可能性
articles.summary: 2026年世界貿易報告書は、多角的貿易システム強化が2050年までに世界GDPを約3%増加させると予測。改革無策は最大10%の損失を招く可能性を警告する。

articles.title: WTO Public Forum 2026 spotlights role of services in driving world trade
articles.description: The 2026 edition of the WTO's Public Forum kicked off on 15 September in Geneva under the theme Powering the Future. Over three days, the Forum will welcome more than 4,600 participants from business, governments, civil society, academia and international organizations to discuss how trade in services is a key engine of development, a source of income, and a driver of job creation and empowerment worldwide.
articles.titleJa: WTO公開フォーラム2026、世界貿易を推進するサービス業の役割に焦点を当てる
articles.summary: ジュネーブで開催されたWTO公開フォーラム2026では、4,600人以上が参加し、サービス貿易が開発、収入、雇用創出の主要な原動力であることについて議論した。

articles.title: World Trade & Tech Day: AI and trade increasingly intertwined
articles.description: Hundreds of participants gathered at the WTO for World Trade & Tech Day on 14 September, a sign of how AI is fundamentally changing the way cross-border commerce is evolving. Under the banner of "AI and Trade: Turning Potential into Progress", the day consisted of a full day of panel discussions and other knowledge-sharing opportunities aimed at fostering conversations on technology and trade. The event shone a spotlight on how AI and frontier technologies are making international trade more efficient, bringing together government leaders as well as academics and private sector representatives to discuss ways to harness AI's potential into tangible economic gains and an engine for inclusive growth.
articles.titleJa: 世界貿易・テクノロジーデー：AIと貿易の結びつきがますます深まる
articles.summary: WTOの世界貿易・テクノロジーデーでは、AIが越境通商を根本的に変えつつあることが議論された。AIの可能性を経済的利益と包摂的成長に転換する方法を探る。

articles.title: Russian Federation notifies launch of safeguard investigation on certain flat steel products
articles.description: On 9 September 2026, the Russian Federation notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards regarding the initiation on 7 September 2026 of a safeguard investigation on certain flat steel products with polymer coating imported into the customs territory of the Eurasian Economic Union.
articles.titleJa: ロシア連邦、特定の鋼板製品に対するセーフガード調査の開始を通知
articles.summary: ロシア連邦は、ユーラシア経済連合に輸入される特定のポリマーコーティング鋼板製品に対するセーフガード調査を2026年9月7日に開始したとWTOに通知した。

articles.title: WTO study explores the role of stablecoins in international trade
articles.description: The WTO Secretariat launched a new publication on the role of stablecoins in supporting cross-border trade on 14 September on the sidelines of the WTO's first World Trade and Tech Day. The report, prepared by the Economic Research and Statistics Division and the Trade in Services and Investment Division, examines the opportunities and challenges associated with the use of stablecoins in facilitating international trade, highlighting how they can accelerate cross-border payments and their potential to increase participation in the international trading system, especially for developing economies.
articles.titleJa: WTO、国際貿易におけるステーブルコインの役割を探る研究を発表
articles.summary: WTO事務局の新しい報告書は、国境を越えた貿易におけるステーブルコインの機会と課題を検討。特に途上国での決済加速や参加促進の可能性を強調する。

articles.title: Goods barometer points to resilient trade growth despite headwinds
articles.description: Global goods trade continued to strengthen in mid-2026 despite persistent geopolitical and policy-related uncertainties, according to the WTO Goods Trade Barometer released on 9 September 2026.
articles.titleJa: 物品貿易バロメーター、逆風にもかかわらず回復力のある貿易成長を示す
articles.summary: WTOの物品貿易バロメーターによると、地政学的・政策的不確実性があるにもかかわらず、2026年半ばにかけて世界の物品貿易は引き続き強化された。

articles.title: WTO issues 2026 Annual Report
articles.description: The WTO published today (9 September) its 2026 Annual Report, providing a comprehensive account of the organization’s activities in 2025 and the early part of 2026. The Report looks back at recent key events, such as the 14th Ministerial Conference in March 2026, and describes the WTO's work in addressing the challenges and opportunities facing world trade.
articles.titleJa: WTO、2026年年次報告書を発行
articles.summary: WTOは2025年と2026年初頭の活動を網羅する2026年年次報告書を発表。第14回閣僚会議などの主要イベントや、世界貿易の課題と機会への取り組みを詳述している。

articles.title: New report highlights growth potential of digital trade in Latin America, Caribbean
articles.description: A new report by the WTO Secretariat, the Inter-American Development Bank (IDB) and the World Bank examines how digital trade is transforming the way Latin American and Caribbean (LAC) economies connect to international markets and identifies opportunities to unlock further growth, inclusion and development for the region.
articles.titleJa: 新報告書、ラテンアメリカ・カリブ海地域のデジタル貿易の成長可能性を強調
articles.summary: WTOなどが共同で作成した報告書は、デジタル貿易がラテンアメリカ・カリブ海地域の経済を国際市場と結びつけ、さらなる成長、包摂、開発の機会を特定する。

articles.title: Madagascar Launches Safeguard Investigation on Certain Types of Rice
articles.description: On 2 September 2026, Madagascar notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated on 31 August 2026 a safeguard investigation on imports of hulled rice, semi-whitened or whitened rice, polished or glazed, and broken rice.
articles.titleJa: マダガスカル、特定の種類の米に対するセーフガード調査を開始
articles.summary: マダガスカルは2026年8月31日、精米、半精米、精白米、砕米の輸入に対するセーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通知した。
